name: ink-studio
description: Prototype playable pixel-art web games with Ink Studio.

interface.shortDescription: Prototype playable pixel-art web games with Ink Studio.
interface.longDescription: Describe a game mechanic. The Agent builds an editable browser game with procedural pixel-art scenes and checks the controls in OhMyGame's playtest.
defaultPrompt: Use Ink Studio to build an original 30-second dodging game in one arena. Give the player a clear warning before each expanding wave, movement with WASD or the arrow keys, a win for surviving, and a restart button. Playtest it before handing it over.
